title: Breuil-Mezard conjecture: equality of the Galois and automorphic sides
exact_target: The cited Breuil–Mézard formulation compares a Galois deformation-ring multiplicity with a weighted automorphic multiplicity, not the undefined representation equality printed in the catalogue.

sources.citation: AIM workshop problem list, p-adic Representations, Modularity, and Beyond.
